record.paper_title: Research Problems in Function Theory (New Edition)
record.original_question: If z1 = 1, and the zi are arbitrary complex numbers for 2 ≤ i ≤ n, then Atkinson [35] proved that max |Sk | > c 1≤k≤n with c = 13 . What is the best value for the constant c?

evidence.quote: If z1 = 1, and the zi are arbitrary complex numbers for 2 ≤ i ≤ n, then Atkinson [35] proved that max |Sk | > c 1≤k≤n with c = 13 . What is the best value for the constant c?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For complex numbers $z_1, z_2, \ldots, z_n$ with $z_1 = 1$ and $z_2, \ldots, z_n$ arbitrary, define the power sums
$$S_k = \sum_{j=1}^{n} z_j^k, \qquad k = 1, 2, \ldots, n.$$
Let
$$R_n = \inf_{z_2, \ldots, z_n \in \mathbb{C}} \; \max_{1 \le k \le n} |S_k|, \qquad R = \liminf_{n \to \infty} R_n.$$
It is known that $R \ge \tfrac{1}{6}$ (and in fact $R_n > \tfrac12$ for all $n \ge 2$, with $R_n < 1$). Determine the best (largest) absolute constant $c$ such that
$$\max_{1 \le k \le n} |S_k| > c$$
holds for every choice of $z_2, \ldots, z_n \in \mathbb{C}$ when $z_1 = 1$ — equivalently, determine $\inf_{n \ge 1} R_n$ (or $\lim_{n\to\infty} R_n$).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of determining the optimal constant in Turán's pure power sum problem (with normalization z_1 = 1) is still open. Atkinson's lower bound 1/6 has been improved (with results showing 1/2 < R_n < 1 for n ≥ 2), but the exact value (and even the limit of R_n as n → ∞) remains undetermined; numerical evidence suggests a limit below 0.7.

status_evidence.title: Turán's pure power sum problem
status_evidence.snippet: Studies R_n with normalization z_1=1; bounds 1/2 < R_n < 1 for n ≥ 2.
status_evidence.claim: Best constant not known; problem open with improved bounds beyond Atkinson's 1/6.

status_evidence.title: An improved estimate in a power sum problem of Turán
status_evidence.snippet: Improvements over Atkinson's lower bound for the Turán power sum problem.
status_evidence.claim: Improvements known but exact optimal constant still undetermined.

status_evidence.title: Explicit solutions to certain inf max problems from Turán power sum theory
status_evidence.snippet: Numerical/explicit solutions suggest a limiting constant less than 0.7.
status_evidence.claim: Limiting value of R_n remains an open problem.
